tools.name: aitab_list_ai_plans
tools.description: Use when the user asks what AI plans cost (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Perplexity, Cursor, Copilot, Midjourney and others), or before aitab_total_ai_subscriptions to look up plan keys. Returns each service with its plans, USD monthly and yearly list prices and the key to pass on. Prices were checked on

tools.name: aitab_total_ai_subscriptions
tools.description: Use when the user lists the AI tools they pay for and asks what they spend per month or year, whether they are paying for overlapping tools, or what a stack of AI subscriptions costs. Returns the monthly, yearly and daily total, overlaps between plans, plans already included in another plan they pay
